email.footer: You are receiving this e-mail because a Kwatt account uses this address. Cowries are never worth real money.
email.ignore: If you did not make this request, ignore this message: your account is still safe.

verify.subject: {{code}} is your Kwatt code
verify.title: Verify your address
verify.intro: Welcome {{pseudo}}! Here is your code to verify your e-mail address:

reset.subject: {{code}} to choose a new Kwatt password
reset.title: Forgotten password
reset.intro: Here is your code to choose a new password:
reset.expires: It expires in 10 minutes. After 5 tries, ask for a new code.

password_changed.subject: Your Kwatt password has changed
password_changed.title: Password changed
password_changed.intro: The password of the account {{pseudo}} has just been changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
password_changed.help: If this was not you, use “Forgot your password?” in the app right away.

deletion.subject: Deletion of your Kwatt account
deletion.title: Deletion requested
deletion.intro: The deletion of the account {{pseudo}} is recorded. Your data will be permanently erased on {{date}}.
deletion.cancel: Changed your mind? Sign in again before that date: the deletion will be cancelled.

your_turn.title: Your turn
your_turn.body: Your game is waiting: your move.

challenge_accepted.title: Challenge accepted
challenge_accepted.body: {{from}} accepts your challenge: the game is starting.

match_ready.title: Everyone is here
match_ready.body: {{leagueName}}: the game is starting, your move.

started.title: League started
started.body: {{leagueName}} has started: your schedule is ready.

cancelled.title: League cancelled
cancelled.body: {{leagueName}} was cancelled: your cowries are returned.

validate_due.title: Registration closed
validate_due.body: {{leagueName}}: {{entrants}} players signed up. Confirm the league within 48 h.

forfeit.title: Forfeit
forfeit.body: {{leagueName}}: a forfeit was recorded in your match.

excluded.title: Removed from the league
excluded.body: {{leagueName}}: you were excluded after your forfeits. {{refund}} cowries are returned.

player_excluded.title: A player was excluded
player_excluded.body: {{leagueName}}: {{pseudo}} was excluded. You move from #{{before}} to #{{after}}.

removed.title: Removed from the league
removed.body: {{leagueName}}: the organiser removed you. Your entry is returned.

time_proposed.title: Time proposed
time_proposed.body: {{leagueName}}: your opponent proposes {{time}} for your match.

board_chosen.title: Board chosen
board_chosen.body: {{leagueName}}: the board for your match is chosen.

knockout_started.title: Knockout stage
knockout_started.body: {{leagueName}}: you're through to the knockout stage!

photo_approved.title: Photo approved
photo_approved.body: Your profile photo is now visible to everyone.

photo_rejected.title: Photo declined
photo_rejected.body: Your profile photo was not accepted: your avatar is still shown.

share.install_ask: Ask the person who invited you for the install link.

room.title: Kwatt room invitation
room.heading: You're invited to a room
room.install_step2: Open the app, tap “Join with a code” and enter the code {{code}}.

league.title: Kwatt league invitation
league.heading: You're invited to a league
league.install_step2: Open the app, go to “Leagues” and enter the code {{code}}.

invalid.title: Invalid link
invalid.body: This share link does not exist or was copied wrongly. Ask your friend for a new link.
